title: iRacing Ferrari Challenge Phillip Island Track Guide 1:25.3 - Ferrari 296 Challenge Phillip Island

corners.label: T1
corners.line: trail braking, back on gas at apex

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: start braking at lower tire wall on right

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: brake halfway along the dirt patch, 65-70%
corners.gear: hold until apex, trail off in 3rd
corners.exit: start picking up gas at apex

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: brake at end of white and blue rumble strip, 50%
corners.exit: start picking up gas at apex

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: Start braking halfway along the rumble strip, 40%.

corners.label: T10
corners.braking: Brake two to three car lengths before the 50m board, 65-70%.
corners.exit: Slowly trail off, back on gas.

corners.label: T12
corners.line: floor it all the way through

general_tips: floor it all the way through turn 12
